aggregation_rules.correlation: Pearson and Spearman when cardinality >= 3; otherwise report insufficient cardinality
aggregation_rules.matched_mismatched: use the frozen v0.31 matched and class-preserving-mismatched mappings
aggregation_rules.missing_metric_rule: If a required diagnostic was not recorded in frozen artifacts, mark NOT_AVAILABLE; do not recreate it via retraining or modified evaluation.
aggregation_rules.training_diagnostics: aggregate per formal architecture and seed, then report pooled and seed-stratified summaries
aggregation_rules.validation_diagnostics: use frozen condition-level means across seeds when comparing corruption strata

analysis_type: post-hoc characterization of already-frozen training/validation evidence

allowed: v0.31 frozen training artifacts from Step5/Step6
v0.31 frozen validation evaluation artifacts from Step9/Step10
training-only diagnostics already generated during v0.31 runs
prohibited: new labels or manually curated post-exposure subsets

interpretation_rule.weak_target_signal: std(delta_u) < 0.01 OR >= 0.75 of u_target lies in [0.45,0.55]

V32_Q1_target_signal.purpose: Determine whether delta_u/u_target contain sufficient learning signal.

interpretation_rule.candidate_space_failure: beneficial candidate fraction < 0.40 AND harmful candidate fraction >= beneficial candidate fraction

V32_Q2_candidate_action_quality.purpose: Determine whether the frozen candidate action is beneficial often enough to justify utility learning.
required_metrics: mean positive delta_u conditional on benefit
mean negative delta_u conditional on harm

V32_Q3_target_transform_compression.purpose: Assess whether the fixed temperature 0.05 maps available delta_u variation into a useful utility-target distribution.

interpretation_rule.selector_nonlearning: final u_hat std < 0.02 AND active intervention rate == 0.0

V32_Q4_selector_learning.purpose: Determine whether the utility head moved away from neutral initialization.
required_metrics: u_hat mean/std by epoch if recorded
utility-head parameter delta from initialization if recoverable without retraining

V32_Q5_evidence_utility_discrimination.purpose: Test whether learned utility separates meaningful reliability states.
required_metrics: correlation between u_hat and realized degradation
correlation between u_hat and realized performance delta vs M4qcs-w

V32_Q6_failure_attribution.decision_rule: Attribution must follow the frozen Q1-Q5 diagnostic rules. No new category or threshold may be introduced after characterization results are exposed.

next_step: Step2 read-only evidence availability and schema preflight before any v0.32 characterization computation.
scientific_role: mechanism diagnosis only; no new performance claim
